purpose: Desired public outcomes and measured baseline evidence. Root-cause suggestions are separate and are not implementation requirements.

baseline.workingTree: Outcome tests and minimal QA support only; production code unchanged.
baseline.assertionReached: D5-003 yes; D5-006 ratings answers observed but wrong population assertion corrected for next run; D5-002/AUD-001 response envelope premise corrected; D5-001 Feed subjects hidden before graph work; Zones setup no; D5-004 persistent fault no
baseline.expectedGate: Intentionally failing baseline regression, never a passing done gate.
baseline.currency: Required Goal check adopted current main 95945af96a (Goal tooling/docs/QA guard fixes only). API owners remain production-equivalent to 7df2e285d3. sourceRevision is the exact tested worker head; revision identifies that unchanged production baseline.

attempts.diagnosis: All capabilities shared one beforeAll; public reply construction was still running when Access connection timeouts appeared. No retained corpus or outcome evidence was produced. This is not proof of any reported API read defect.
attempts.correction: Separate capability-named files using the unchanged catalogue-disk class and 480-second wall; real followed chapters exercise the reported Feed subject reader; independent rating Accounts avoid unrelated Realm creation.

capabilities.diagnosis: Public fixtures were created, but stopped backup refused the raw-update mode of an unclassified source stack. No outcome assertion.
Real followed-chapter producer reached head >= 24; backup then refused source raw-update mode. No stream, unread or cancellation assertion.

Extra Zone creation returned authority_denied (403): fixture omitted the explicit space:create:root / space.create mandate. This is setup admission, not a suggestions defect. Later diagnosis: baseline-member quota takes precedence over that grant; operator preparation is required for this fixture population.
All 100 real independent Account observations were acknowledged; clean PostgreSQL stop verification failed before backup, followed by raw-update-mode cleanup refusal. No aggregate assertion.

attempts.correction: Classify the four command-built corpora for the product assembler, grant only the missing fixture creation mandate, and bound independent Account signup / observation preparation concurrency at four / two. Public outcome assertions, 600-second preparation ceiling, 480-second project wall and all candidate limits stay unchanged.

cleanup.scope: Only four disposable stacks 20261018t192818-8c2569-{1,2,3,4}, using task stack:reset -- --profile qa --run-id <id> --persistent --raw-update

capabilities.diagnosis: D5-003 body reached for six personas; unrelated graph advancement caused one foreground population audit in all six traces. Twelve exact absent/private phrase controls and diagnostic control passed. D5-002/AUD-001 incorrectly unwrapped the query envelope: their TypeErrors are not API defects. Stranger default returned a raw 503/deadline, separately observed.

Project exceeded 480 seconds. All five readers received 24 real Feed notices with null subjects/display, so four cancellation preconditions saw zero graph calls. Moderator only exercised an unrelated existing role notice. All six admission/missing/alien controls passed. This run does not prove the audited Feed budget/cancellation.

No suggestions assertion. Extra Zone returned 403 because member baseline creation quota was exhausted; an explicit fixture mandate does not bypass the earlier baseline-member admission branch. Next fixture uses the existing operator for population preparation.

All six personas observed 200 at 100 and 422 query_budget_exceeded at both 101 and 102. Test incorrectly expected population to contain the policy string; corrected to population=N and populationPolicy=global-account-principal before counting a failing boundary assertion.

attempts.correction: Unwrap query.result; use numeric aggregate population and separate populationPolicy; prepare Zones as operator; replace hidden Feed hot-path premise with 24 real governance role notices per reader from a separate Account in an auxiliary Realm. Reuse the stopped query/rating cuts, retaining the previous Feed evidence.

fixture.composition: Real Account HTTP and composeMain with lifecycle, relay, Content, Access, Fuseki and PostgreSQL; no owner mocks.
fixture.creation: Public commands for Works, chapter Content/eligibility, real follows, independent Realm role-impact/change receipts and produced notices, operator-created Realms/Zones, and independent Account rating observations. Only the existing fixture authority helper supplies narrow preparation mandates.
fixture.reuse: Consistent stopped backups and mode-0600 corpus.json under .temp/audit-bounded-reads/{queries,notifications-governance,zones,ratings}/owners. The original notifications directory retains the disproved Feed fixture evidence. Every execution restores fresh isolated owners; no shared development storage.
fixture.privacy: Retained credentials never enter this document or Git.
fixture.instrumentation: Transparent HTTP proxy records actual graph requests, bytes, timing and trace IDs; optional 20 ms latency exposes in-flight cancellation without replacing an owner. Real OTLP runtime propagates traces. SQL/engine bounds are unknown until separately instrumented, never inferred as zero.

populations.notifications: One real followed-chapter notice plus 24 acknowledged permission changes affecting each of five signed-in recipients, authored by a separate Account in an auxiliary public Realm. Last change removes auxiliary permissions. Primary Realm persona roles remain unchanged. Stream limit 50 and unread scan 256 remain unchanged.
populations.zones: Ten operator-created public Realm/Zone pairs prepared through public commands; the first eight official at the retained cut, then the ninth and tenth configured official in the test. Each adopts the same public original through its own Realm-local selection.

fixture.preparationScope: Each capability build and restore independently remains within the existing 600-second active preparation ceiling; each regression project retains its existing 480-second wall. No raised timeout, candidate or population verifier limit.
fixture.setupProgress: Preparation emits phase/count/elapsed records with assertionReached false, so a setup failure cannot be reported as an outcome assertion.
fixture.productAssembler: All four API-built corpus files are commandOnlyIntegrationFiles. This keeps source capture and restored product owners in the same closed raw-update mode.
fixture.corpusLifetime: New primary moderator and auxiliary notice assignments last 24 hours to support reusable cuts. Earlier query/rating cuts retain their original one-hour primary moderator validity; exact run timestamps determine that persona premise. Account sessions are freshly authenticated after each restore.

distinctions.null: Absent optional subject/display/rating/diagnostic value; never fabricate a preview or zero count.
distinctions.unknown: Membership count or unmeasured SQL/engine work stays unknown; do not turn it into exact zero.
distinctions.incomplete: A partial page carries an advancing continuation and at-least count, even when items is empty.
distinctions.unavailable: An unready/unavailable owner is an explicit 503; never return an exact empty page or null rating to hide it.
distinctions.noData: An exact zero-rating population has mean null and no-data precision; it differs from an unavailable aggregate.

resourceList.explanation: Existing resource-list 32 plus existing Realm-directory supplement 163 for mixed all scope.
resourceList.sqlMeasurement: unknown; graph wire trace is measured

notificationRead.scope: One complete stream request or unread-count request, including all subject hydration and fences.
notificationRead.sqlEngineBudget: Required shared allocation; concrete instrumentation/limits remain unproved here.

chapterSearch.notes: No timeout or MAX_PUBLIC_UNITS increase is a repair.

suggestions.notes: Existing bounded candidate window stays; total official population may grow.

globalAggregate.notes: One whole-request allocation; no raising 100-slot verifier ceiling to satisfy the population test.

refreshDesired.contract: Terminal permanent evidence is retained and isolated until basis/source changes; ordinary transient faults retain bounded retry. No fixed perpetual retry hides permanent invalidity.
